scope: Synthetic train-only Bayesian timing posterior compared with frozen logistic score; it does not change deployed inference.

protocol.hypotheses: Ovulation day 1..45 or absent, using the generator's event-day convention.
protocol.prior: Train-fitted calendar/static prior for timing and absence, no dynamic test labels.
protocol.likelihood: Train-only pre/post-event Gaussian temperature, RHR and HRV parameters. Skip missing observations. Fixed likelihood temperature of one.
protocol.primary_comparison: Day-18 Tier-2, patient-cluster CI for twin Brier minus logistic Brier. Promote only if the upper 95% bound is at most the predeclared margin. Otherwise retain the twin as an interpretation layer.

promotion: integrate only if pooled upper patient-cluster bound is <= margin; this implementation remains a separate interpretation layer.
status: noninferior synthetic check; still separate interpretation layer
